column7: Catch-all: correct for Statement/report hubs, a stretch where a location or a specific role is meant.
Bare counts ("1.5 million", "one confirmed case") are QuantitativeValue; Quantity is the abstract measure supertype.
schema.org source is the cause of an InstantaneousEvent; used here for reporting attribution.
Semantic patient role is right; hub subjects are Events, not Actions (see domain columns).
Friend, "executive vice president" are role labels; schema.org Role is a reification wrapper, not a label type.
Domain is Observation; the subjects are report and count hubs.
Right concept for "months"; "this weekend"/"overnight" are date ranges, not ISO 8601 durations.
Object is the reporting period, not the item's own running length.
schema.org has no general foodstuff class; Substance is the closest available.
Monday morning, "broad daylight" are not hh:mm:ss points in time.
Used between an award and a tournament and between two count nodes; schema.org hasPart is CreativeWork-scoped.
Prize money attached to a tournament rank is not an offer price.
misinformation risks is not a code drawn from a code set.
four people is a counted quantity with a unit, not a bare integer literal.
60,000 people carries a unit; Number is the bare literal datatype.
438 deaths is an observed value, not the variable being measured.
Vehicle acceleration property matched to "AI --> process"; surface-form match only.
Accessibility input-method property matched to "software --> algorithms".
Drug administration route matched to "administration --> Trump" on the string "administration".
schema.org affectedBy is MedicalTest to Drug; used here for weather impact.
schema.org cause is MedicalCondition to MedicalCause; no general causal property exists, so this is the best available.
The person reported the finding rather than creating the described state of affairs.
MusicRelease credit property used for "audit findings --> Radio France", the outlet that reported them.
Jack Antonoff --drugClass--> Friend is nonsensical.
Links a strike event to a plea; schema.org event associates an Event with a place, organization or action.
Superseded plural form; the assertion itself (Place to Event) is sound.
Spain and France do not geospatially overlap; the text asserts adjacency.
Biochemical-entity part property used for "culinary ingredients --> herbs".
Tourist-attraction property matched to "Borg cipher --> alphabets".
Sheriff --legislationLegalForce--> Spokane County is nonsensical.
A host city is not the organizer of the World Cup.
Domain is Service; the subject is a use-case hub.
The person is making the claim, not providing a service.
The BBC is the source of a confirmation, not the sender of a message.
broad daylight is not a DateTime.
A pressure system over Portugal is a location, not the endpoint of a MoveAction.
half the nation is a vague extent; DefinedRegion is for shipping and delivery regions.
two antiviral drugs are drug instances, not a pharmacological class.
An epicentre is a point location, not a landform.
schema.org Researcher is an Audience subtype, not a person type.
toddler read as a clothing size group; the text means a young child.
jewelry as a placeholder for multiple similar products; Product is the plain choice.
Undeciphered Status is a status value, not an enumeration type.
